visual_summary: In orbit above a planet, a figure addresses Tonto about finding a single living cell. Inside a dense, futuristic laboratory, a masked or goggled technician operates machinery as a detected cell is used to begin a cloning process. A large vertical chamber glows with white light while a humanoid body develops in stages below, progressing from cellular matter to skeleton, musculature, and finally a fully formed pale adult human.
